item.title: Minnesota weather: Record Valentine's Day warmth, sunny weekend ahead
item.description: Expect very warm temperatures on Valentine's Day weekend that will last into the early part of next week.Saturday forecastTemperatures will trend very warm again today. Highs will peak near 40 degrees across the international border to the upper 50s in southwestern Minnesota. The Twin Cities will likely be breaking records again today, with the old record sitting at 50 degrees set in 1882. item.title: Minnesota weather: Multiple warm temperature records broken Valentine's Day
item.description: Many areas across Minnesota saw record warmth this Valentine's Day. Record-breaking warmth Temperatures rose across the state, making for a nice Valentine's Day. The high temperature in the Twin Cities Saturday was 54 degrees, beating the record of 50 degrees set in 1882. Warmth set to continueTemperatures are expected to stay about the same on Sunday, with low 50s expected in the Twin Cities and 60s in southern Minnesota.
